faqs.a:
No contract shall be entered into for construction work under this article unless
               the contractor shall give an undertaking with a sufficient surety approved by the
               council and in an amount fixed by it for the faithful performance of the contract,
               substantially as required by C.R.S. § 38-26-106, except as herein expressly otherwise
               provided.
(Code 1981, § 27-56; Ord. No. 551, § 19(G), 5-14-1964)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 31-25-516; contractor executes bond, C.R.S. § 38-26-106.
